captions.title: Open the listing that sold
captions.line: Listings, then the property. Everything about the sale starts on its own screen.

captions.title: Record the sale
captions.line: It sits in the status picker, and it says up front what it will ask you for.

captions.title: This one is AV Homes' own
captions.line: Whose property it is decides what the sale pays out, so the sheet says which.

captions.title: What it actually sold for
captions.line: The asking price is already there. This one went for 158 million, not the 165 it was listed at.

captions.title: Who closed it
captions.line: A marketer is paid up their referral chain. Staff and walk-ins are not, and both funds still take their share either way.

captions.title: Who bought it
captions.line: The name and number are what make the record traceable a year from now.

captions.title: The proof
captions.line: A receipt, a bank alert, or the signed agreement. At least one, and the form will not go on without it.

captions.title: Record it and close the listing
captions.line: One button, because it does both: the money goes on the record and the house comes off the market.

captions.title: Closed, with proof behind it
captions.line: If it falls through, cancel the deal: the commission reverses and both funds give their share back.
